description: Create a new API key on this account and return it once. The new key can never be broader than the key making the call: same or fewer capabilities, the same source-IP limit, no later expiry, no higher per-minute limit, only account read scopes this key has, and never any write scope. At most 20 keys per account per UTC day this way. Returns object api_key with key_id, api_key (the secret, shown only in this response), prefix, name, note, status, scope_mode, scopes, ip_allow and expires_at. Example: {"name": "crawler-prod", "ip_allow": ["203.0.113.10"], "expires_at": "2026-12-31T23:59:59Z"}. Needs the keys:write account scope, which is off by default and can only be granted by the account owner in the console.

account_scopes.description: Account read scopes for the new key; only ones this key has

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z; omit to copy this key's expiry, and never later than it

ip_allow.description: Source IPs or CIDR ranges, IPv4 or IPv6, up to 20. If this key has an IP limit, omit to copy it, or list only addresses from it

note.description: Up to 500 characters, for your own records

scope_mode.description: Omit to copy this key's own capability scope

name: everyinfra_key_create
title: Create an API key
